biography.concept: Eldest of the cinema-vigil family outside the Hidden Vault — Menhirkin Dreamwalker, T III, Initiation 13 (Act 3).
biography.notes: Karsden is the family's memory. A Menhirkin who stood up out of the Polygonal Grove's own bedrock, slow to speak and impossible to hurry, Karsden keeps the Night of the Premiere in dream: the old films are shown in the Yesod-side, projected on the back of closed eyelids, because the projector died a generation ago. The family's rites are Karsden's dreams, remembered aloud. Karsden does not believe the 300th Customer is coming. Karsden keeps the seat warm anyway.

description.value:
"The land is not scenery. The land is a person. You are the version of it that finally stood up and walked over to complain."

You are not descended from the land. You are the land. A hex decided to become a person and the person is you. The standing stones on the ridge are distant cousins. The bedrock under the bunker is a grandparent. Mortals call you a Hex-Giant. You don't correct them.

Creature Type. Humanoid (Menhirkin). Size. Medium, but you count as Large for carrying capacity and the size of creatures you can shove or grapple. Speed. 6 squares

Heartstone (passive). A fragment of your home hex is literally inside you. While in any hex your Domain controls or has claimed: reroll the lowest die on Body checks, and you cannot be forcibly removed from the hex against your will (teleportation, banishment, forced march) without first being reduced to 0 Integrity.

Land Memory (1/Soma Break). Lay a hand on any surface older than you; the GM tells you one true thing the land remembers.

Living Rampart (1/Soma Break). Reaction — when a creature you can see targets an ally adjacent to you with an attack, the attacker rolls 3d10 keep lowest 2 on that attack roll.

Stonebound (passive). Reroll the lowest die on Body checks to resist being pushed, knocked Prone, or otherwise forcibly moved. Reroll the lowest die on Body checks to build, repair, or fortify structures, siegeworks, and defensive emplacements.

Domain Edge. Your Domain gains +20 Violence marks and +20 Non-Lethal marks at campaign start.

description.value:
“What you are now is not what you were. The pressure was the point.”

Menhirkin (Metamorphic). You are land that was buried, squeezed, heated, and came back up harder and more interesting. Every Metamorphic has a before-self — a softer version of themselves that got pressed into something else. You remember being that. You are not going back.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Menhirkin).

  • Size. Medium.

  • Movement. 6 squares walking.

  • Lineage Lean. Menhirkin does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Body in fiction and through Tier powers.

Menhirkin Core: The Land Stood Up

Shared across all Menhirkin heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item.

  • Stone Soul. You count as Large for carry, shove, and grapple despite your Medium frame. You reroll the lowest die on checks to resist being forcibly moved.

  • Hex Recognition. Once per scene, while you are on a natural surface you are directly touching, you may whisper a single question about the place. The GM answers with one true thing the land knows.

  • Slow to Wear. You reroll the lowest die on Body checks against Stress, long-duration physical wear, forced marches, climate exposure, and sustained labor. You do not tire the way softer things tire.

  • Heavy Presence. Your weight and settledness are perceptible. Creatures within 2 squares of you know you are there even if they cannot see you; you roll 3d10 keep lowest 2 on Intrigue (Stealth) checks unless you are on or in stone.

Metamorphic Traits

  • Pressure Remade. At the end of each Soma Break, the day chooses what you are until your next Soma Break. Roll a d4 or pick (GM discretion): (1) +1 Guard, (2) resistance to kinetic damage, (3) +1 rank on one skill of your choice, (4) reroll-lowest on Body checks to resist being knocked prone or grappled. You announce the result; you do not pre-pick.

  • Unbreakable Core. You reroll the lowest die on defense checks against petrification, forced transmutation, and forced shape-change. You have been turned into something else once already; nobody does it twice without your say-so.

Domain Edge

  • Domain Edge. Your Domain gains +20 Intrigue marks and +20 Non-Lethal marks at campaign start.

description.value:
"The future is just memory pointed the other way."

The Dreamwalker reads the Tree and works manifestations — and that work is the fuel. You run on Surge like everyone, but yours arrives when you cast a manifestation (bank +1, max +2/round).

The Oracle (spent via Surge)

  • Omen (1) — you or an ally saw the thread coming: banks a reroll-lowest.
  • Dream Ward (2) — an ally drifts into a protective dreamstate: DR + a reroll.
  • Shared Dream (3) — allies within 6 squares bank a reroll and draw 1 Clarity (refuels their casting).
  • Reality Hack (5) — rewrite the moment: the party banks a reroll and one enemy rolls its next attack rolling 3d10 and keeping the lowest 2.

The Dream-Cache endures — bank a manifestation between scenes, deploy it next scene without paying Clarity. And the oracle's quiet work stays out of combat: Dream-Sense still reads a hex's Sephirah, and you still put your one question to the Great Work (Initiate of the Great Work) for a true answer.

items.name: Trance of the Quiet Sun (Bad Eden)

description.value:
"Stillness is the loudest thing."

Mode: Contemplative

The Quiet Sun is the dreamer who stops the room by going still. Your Surge spends turn perception and patience into mechanics — seeing clearly, refusing a death, and forcing a beat of peace into a fight that didn't ask for one.

Trance (spent via Surge)

  • Still Attention (1) — you and allies within 6 squares bank a reroll-lowest.
  • Somnolent Peace (2) — the next lethal blow against an ally drops them to 1 Integrity (unconscious), not dead.
  • Radiant Pause (3) — nearby enemies are Calmed: a contemplative beat where violence stalls.

Out-of-combat: Somnolent Peace, Stillness Between, Lull the Riot, Quiet March, Daybreak and Solar Stillpoint remain the strategic flourishes.

Tier 1 — Oneiric Reservoir. Your Clarity maximum is +2. On Soma Break you recover Clarity equal to your tier instead of the flat default. Detect Spark resonance in adjacent hexes (carryover).

Discipline (passive): Clarity max +2. Skill rank +1 in Perception and Faith.

Tier 3 — The Walking Lane (Signature Mode). Stance. While the Lane is open, your sustained manifestations reach into adjacent realms (astral / dream / memory) — ignore one band of cover or distance for any one effect per round, and the GM is invited to attach a narrative hook (someone notices you went somewhere). Pays ongoing upkeep.

description.value:
Enduring Focus

You hold your will together when others lose it.

Rules

You reroll the lowest die on Body checks made to maintain Clarity hold. Additionally, you can shape a working’s gestures even with weapons or a shield in hand.

⚙ Body checks reroll the lowest die; the Clarity-hold gate is read by the GM.

Steady Hand

When it goes wrong, your discipline pulls the backlash short.

Rules

When a manifestation misfires, the result lands one band safer — your control biases the backlash toward the mild end of the table.

⚙ Applies automatically: misfire band shifted −1 (safer).
